title: Remove global from prek CI scripts
body:
Another small increment to remove global statements for PR https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/58116

This removes global statement in prek CI scripts. Once does not need a `global`, the other can be wrapped in a class to hold static variables.

`global` is evil.

files.patch:
@@ -55,8 +55,12 @@
 
 ALLOWED_SUB_FOLDERS_OF_TESTS = ["unit", "system", "integration"]
 
-should_fail = False
-fatal_error = False
+

+    fatal_error: bool = False

+        _ErrorSignals.should_fail = True
 
-    if should_fail:
+    if _ErrorSignals.should_fail:

             console.print("[red]Also please remove the extra test folders listed above!")
